lines: The road twisted and wound, full of laughter
Running wild through the forest of green leaves
Playing all around, a town of sunlight
Someone is calling me
Summer is coming, shadows rise, I want to see you
What I found was the first star
Will tomorrow be sunny too?
Paprika, when the flowers bloom
Let's sow seeds in the clear sky
Hallelujah, if you've drawn a dream
Let your heart play free and send it to you
Smoldering in the rain, the moon is dimmed
Who was crying in the shade of the trees?
One by one, as if to comfort them
Someone is calling me
When I counted up my joys, they were full of you
What lit the way home
Was the shadow-shape of memories
Paprika, when the flowers bloom
Let's sow seeds in the clear sky
Hallelujah, if you've drawn a dream
Let your heart play free and send it to you
I'm coming to see you, through the rows of trees
Singing a song
Arms full, holding flowers
La-la-li-la

Hallelujah, if you've drawn a dream
Let your heart play free and send it to you
